memoryLimits: No raw/private memory or inferred ownership/store counts. Exported WebAssembly.Memory.buffer.byteLength is capacity only; JavaScript grow wrapping is not guest memory.grow counting. claimGates: No advantage, minimal-deployment, full Node/Web stream, ALS/process/reset/reuse claim. Same-engine binding effects and whole-profile costs are separate; preserve size/RSS regressions and counterexamples.
